_comment: An Another World project brings the game as one file: a .zip of the game's folder - the DOS release's MEMLIST.BIN and BANK files, or the Amiga's or the Atari ST's BANK files - at its top or in a folder, names in any case. The core unpacks it at start into memory no savestate carries.

slots.title: Game files
slots.help: A .zip of Another World's folder: the DOS release (MEMLIST.BIN and BANK01..BANK0D), the Amiga's or the Atari ST's (BANK01..BANK0D). The 15th and 20th Anniversary Editions, the Windows 3.1 and the 3DO releases are not played.
